name: False King
description: A silver-haired man of unnaturally long life whom Sentos spared on Fleet Rock and who gave him the ring.

timeline.summary: The woman stabs Sentos in the back and makes him recount what happened on Fleet Rock, and he says the silver-haired man was the false king.
timeline.quote: "No one told me he was the false king."

timeline.summary: Sentos lies that he spared the false king out of mercy, concealing that he accepted the ring for his wife.
timeline.quote: I did it out of mercy." It was a lie he'd told many times before

relations.note: Sentos spared the false king and received his ring.
relations.quote: I gave him his freedom for the trinket anyway.
